hypothesis: The causal near-ATM put-call skew (skew) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with the subsequent forward realized return kurtosis (fourth standardized moment, tail fatness) of the same underlying, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the EVAL-71 surface floor.
extends: EVAL-71/85/86/97/101/103/111 (same skew signal path and sealed EVAL-71 surface floor) + EVAL-85/117/119 (same forward-window convention, fourth moment instead of third); distinct cell: single-asset skew level -> forward realized return kurtosis

protocol.title: Options near-ATM put-call skew (skew) -> forward own-asset realized return kurtosis predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)
protocol.extends: EVAL-71/85/86/97/101/103/111 (same skew signal path and sealed EVAL-71 surface floor) + EVAL-85/117/119 (same forward-window convention, fourth moment instead of third); distinct cell: single-asset skew level -> forward realized return kurtosis
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- complements EVAL-71/85/86/97/101/103/111/117/119; no traded-form claim
protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-ATM put-call skew (e71.build_surface_bars skew), forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71._forward_fill / e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward realized return kurtosis = m4 / m2**2 over the SAME underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, lr[k:k+h]); fourth standardized moment (tail fatness)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(skew_z_k, kurt_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (higher put-call skew -> fatter forward return tails)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
